notes.title: True Thief: The Team
notes.notes:
[p]These developer diaries are dedicated to the people behind the creation of the stealth RPG True Thief.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf-Db0a5GmoYysCxbe1od9xVR5AWOhtWP9JH8cNzCjGcZNumhwRepl5Y41bVUeZ0psl_zSiq4BEcbc7uQ6hrCVUEzREj_vUUATFN967Q-lzw08eukGpQa7cxAtki-lSahmrQ2jrvw?key=gEsHoTRXbZPYM5KU621Ufw"][/img][/p][p]True Thief is an atmospheric stealth RPG with elements of dark fantasy. Players must hide in the shadows, avoid combat, make difficult decisions, and uncover secrets. At the heart of the plot is a story that hides much more than meets the eye, developed by the Antelus Games team.[/p][p]Today we will tell you about three members of the team: Egor, Maxim, and Anton. One is a lead programmer and game designer, the second is a programmer with character and irony, and the third is the main figure in the studio. Together, they are building a dangerous, dark, and lively world in which the player will become a real Robin Hood under the cover of night.[/p][h3]
Egor[/h3][p][b]Game designer, level designer, lead UE5 programmer[/b][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfslLpNJ7AK6YOMnfY59taIY_24MsmkbMOjPAdz33PvqtYptJsMhM7JB2TC_2oD56IHQjEJB7CIO_HyWlLGPhcEkoZ-qomXmjxqsntLPyA2bMRgQFGEbgP0qwUKmxUV2RZe9fKFJQ?key=gEsHoTRXbZPYM5KU621Ufw"][/img][/p][p][i]I oversee the development of True Thief, set tasks for the team, and actively participate in the work myself, including programming. Before the team started to grow, I did everything related to development on my own.[/i][/p][p][i]Anton invited me to join the team in August 2024 after seeing my post in the Unreal Engine chat. At the time, I was talking about my project for Google Play — he liked my approach, and we started working together. True Thief was a new challenge for me, and I gladly accepted it.[/i][/p][p][i]I like the atmosphere at Antelus Games: it's easy to grow here, everyone supports each other and moves forward with faith in the common cause. I am confident that many people will like the plot of True Thief, and of course, I am confident in our team. We have already received positive feedback on the early version of the game — and this is just the beginning.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Maxim[/h3][p][b]Programmer[/b][/p][p][i][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf2a6iockPztaGkGqGxb07JUJCw3FRUBffRki1sYQPUR_bgrUcAHozfQ3pj_LFJ9Bp1-kM4k9-SyNF6UPViQxdNziH2glD_cdNkBwYm07DNagce2ZFD1tceiSe0RO4GSIZ_ErHo?key=gEsHoTRXbZPYM5KU621Ufw"][/img][/i][/p][p][i]I am responsible for technical implementation: I write code, add features, and periodically berate myself for old decisions. I also like to jokingly complain about myself six months ago — like any developer.[/i][/p][p][i]What do I like about Antelus Games? It's a large team of passionate people. Here you can always find support, ask a question, or just discuss your favorite topic — game development. We don't just write code — we make a game that we ourselves would like to play. Personally, I miss good single-player RPGs with a strong atmosphere — and I know there are many players like me.[/i][/p][p][i]True Thief is a small but very lively project. We put our hearts into it, and I feel that it will be noticed. We don't follow a template — we do what we ourselves want to see. And that is the main key to success.[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Anton[/h3][p][b]Game director, game designer, and scriptwriter for the project, as well as founder of Antelus Games[/b][/p][p][i][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeGJg5Qus2JCcsm62Gkeq8W3dF6li5jGYkxrZAAY8sk_dm5bv8itpHpzUGwebXJX2ARgcf21KyztFXVutQMHRp2EfNOedj_ViqJBVmNgl5nsM9qy0BOlFjAZfrVbj4eYy8wsb58Yg?key=gEsHoTRXbZPYM5KU621Ufw"][/img][/i][/p][p][i]I started working on True Thief on my own back in May 2024 and gradually assembled a team for it. Initially, the idea was to make a game based on Alexei Pekhov's universe, The Chronicles of Siala, featuring Garrett, the Dancer in the Shadows. But after talking to Alexei, I realized that we were too poor to buy the rights to the book. So I decided to create my own dark fantasy, full of secrets and mysteries.[/i][/p][p][i]For me, this project is an outlet for everyone who loves real stealth. This genre has long been forgotten: now it's just a mechanic in other games. I want fans of the genre to be able to enjoy hiding in the shadows again.[/i][/p][p][i]I myself love stealth: as a child, I spent hours playing Splinter Cell, Metal Gear, and Thief. It was especially exciting to play them in an old barn — in complete darkness. By the way, horror games became even scarier there.[/i][/p][p][i]What do I like about Antelus Games? Everything! After all, I created this idea, brand, and studio. Antelus Games is a warm haven for indie developers, a treasure trove of interesting projects for gamers, and already a phenomenon for the industry. A year ago, no one knew about us, but now we are being written about and talked about in various sources and gaming blogs.[/i][/p][p][i]I promise: there will be even more and even more interesting things to come! In the meantime, I invite all gamers to join us on July 27 at 2:00 p.m. for our first online video game festival in Russia, Antelus Games EXPO, where you can check out not only our projects, but also games from other indie developers. It'll all happen on a virtual platform similar to PlayStation Home.[/i][/p][p][i][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcs3-RHfxPiv_9POFBIVD4Z1B-_QsO4_IeiXbzaqthNOYIA3AC1e-eMjWtoWf3G-AsCAn_JMuLlKJZ3IGHSFTEenVdiiCnZ1DOKt8khZYV5hbk6vcjWSBfcwlGnIyKjheJXjoiZrQ?key=gEsHoTRXbZPYM5KU621Ufw"][/img][/i][/p][p][b]Add True Thief to your wish list! We will do our best to make the game interesting and exciting![/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Updated demo version of True Thief
notes.notes:
[p]Friends, by your requests we decided to expand the demo location. In this regard, a number of changes have been added to the demo.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Key changes:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The territory of the location has increased, it became 2 times larger, as well as the number of guards on it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 4 interactive houses with loot and notes revealing the world of True Thief.[/p][/*][*][p]Hiding in the dark has been increased to medium difficulty. Guards can see Enveth better when illuminated, keep an eye on the stealth indicator at the top.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of bugs found by players.[/p][/*][*][p]Added full Russian and English voice acting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for wide monitors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]We hope that now the extended demo will allow players to play longer in the atmosphere of the dark Middle Ages and hide from the guards in the bushes.[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Whose voices are heard in the project
notes.notes:
True Thief is an atmospheric isometric stealth-RPG about the art of survival without violence. No killing - only stealth, agility and the ability to manipulate circumstances. The player will have to find out what happened in this world, what is "Darkness" and how to get out of a difficult situation, in which the main character - Envet Nokt - got into.

Today we want to tell you whose voices bring characters to life in the demo version. Previously, we recorded voice-overs directly with the actors, with no centralized control, so the voices could vary in timbre and intonation.

It's different now. We're working with AniDub Online, and the process is managed by the voice director Eugene Semyonov. Together we have recorded full voice-overs of key characters for Early Access.

[h2]Who will you hear in our project?[/h2]
[u][b]The main character is Envet Nokt[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/1e6cba03f5db3e4a05d6679c8b7257d4a2fdef8d.jpg[/img]
Envet is an experienced thief and a refugee from Mirgard, who caught the beginning of the end. He was able to escape to the capital to start his journey anew, but fate has pushed him back onto the path of thievery. Where will this path lead him to?
🎙 Voiced by Arslanov Timur - the voice of Tanjiro in "The Blade that Splits Demons", Axel in "Lazarus" and many others.

[u][b]Baron - Longrim Borg[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/316a38552cb0016ad4cf40ab2e2edfc99722a7d9.jpg[/img]
The enigmatic and influential Baron L., who influenced Enweth's fate by simply kicking him out of his own house and housing his own spy. Whether we meet him is for our player to find out.
🎙 Voiced by Sharafutdinov Damir - the voice of Corkus in "Berserk", Amory in "Stalcraft", etc.

[u][b]Refugee - Milta[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/67a244d1d2939155a474a97526a81c1ecf2772ba.jpg[/img]
A daring, demanding and ambitious girl. From her first day in the capital city of Orlund, she has done everything in order to get into the central quarter and get out of the slums.
🎙 Voiced by Dorofeeva Ekaterina - the official voice of the YouTube channel with 80 million subscribers. Also: Lara in "A Place in the Sun," Jerietta in "Stop Being a Hero."

[u][b]The undertaker - Miles[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/7ef29799e4d2def777d3e7073b753c8465db9a58.jpg[/img]
An enterprising old dodger who likes to drink and be always in fashion. Many wonder where he gets the money for it. It is up to our player to figure it out.
🎙 Voiced by Sokolov Alexander - rapper J-Zuss in "Not for Broadcast", Talos Rucker in "Deus Ex: Mankind Divided".

[u][b]The harbor master is Robert[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/2578dec5b479c3c0e48da8bf695f40ca343a3d45.jpg[/img]
Nothing gets past the local jack-of-all-trades Robert in Orlund. He's a real businessman and knows anything and everything. Enveth has to face him, but how will it end....
🎙 Voiced by Maslov Andrew - Scorpio in "Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man", Max in "The Callisto Protocol".

[u][b]Enchantress - Aria[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/aeb90cae4b7241bf8cbab941529994337affd20a.jpg[/img]
The proud and powerful Aria, Orlund's court sorceress.
🎙 Voiced by Zagorskaya Tatiana - Anya Forger "Spy Family", Fern "Friren" and many other familiar characters.

[b]We really hope you enjoy the way the characters of the True Thief world sound. This is an important step for us - and your support makes it even more meaningful.[/b]

notes.title: True Thief: mechanics and plot
notes.notes:
[b]True Thief[/b] is an isometric stealth-role-playing game on Unreal Engine 5. The player will have to think over his every move, hide and bypass the guards.

[h2]Game mechanics[/h2]
Breaking locks by passing puzzles. It will be necessary to act as a real medieval thief, not an assassin. True Thief will force the player to be attentive. Memorize every move of the enemies and the terrain. The game will not have a map to help navigate - the player will have to train his memory. The game will not forgive mistakes and will make you return to the save point and go through again, looking for new ways to bypass to achieve your goals.

As you might have guessed, the game is story-oriented and designed for a single player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183374/94488f2d80d656871d1169d89071f759c3015b3f.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's the storyline?[/h2]
The Middle Ages. You have to play as a guy who stepped on the path of thievery. He had no other way to survive in a rotten world.

You will start playing as a ragamuffin from the slums, breaking into houses with a rusty knife, gradually acquiring uniforms and tools for more complex and protected houses.

We will tell a story full of secrets, riddles, mysticism and horror. What trials await our hero? How did he lose everything? And what will his fate lead to? All this and much more, you will find out while passing True Thief.

The genre of the game is, first of all, a puzzle game. The main mechanics is lock picking, will be presented in the form of a puzzle game with procedural generation. Find all the secrets of the lock to open it and break into the house. Next, steal and collect everything that lies bad 🤗
